_**Assistant**_

```sql:flight_query.sql
-- SQL 查询：查找凌晨0点从波士顿出发的航班
SELECT f.*
FROM flight AS f
JOIN airport AS a ON f.from_airport = a.airport_code
JOIN airport_service AS aps ON a.airport_code = aps.airport_code
JOIN city AS c ON aps.city_code = c.city_code
WHERE f.departure_time = 0
  AND c.city_name = '波士顿';
```
